components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The consequential action in a decision region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #d9622e; color: #0a1628; font: 600 12px/1.35 'Geist Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ff6b35; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00d9ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #2a3547; border-radius: 0; background: #12263f; color: #e0e3e5; font: 600 12px/1.35 'Geist Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #00d9ff; color: #00d9ff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00d9ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: A flat, bordered container for one coherent task or status group.
components.html:
CURRENT MODULE

Build a reliable pipeline

Ship the next feature and verify it from your connected repository.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 360px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #2a3547; border-radius: 0; background: #12263f; color: #e0e3e5; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Geist Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 8px 0; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #8395ac; } .ds-card .ds-label { color: #00d9ff; font: 600 11px/1.35 'Geist Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A labeled, theme-safe field with a clear technical focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #e0e3e5; font: 600 11px/1.35 'Geist Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #2a3547; border-radius: 4px; background: #101b2c; color: #e0e3e5; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Geist Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00d9ff; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A compact semantic state, never decorative filler.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,.35); border-radius: 0; background: rgba(16,185,129,.1); color: #10b981; font: 600 11px/1.35 'Geist Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview: Modern Technical Brutalism made usable: sharp, evidence-led, dark-first, and fully resolved for light mode. Member and admin surfaces prioritize orientation, action, recovery, and proof over decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Geist Sans for reading and Geist Mono for system meaning.
Flat by default with earned elevation.
Member and admin workflows stay quieter than marketing.

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange represents commitment; cyan represents orientation and feedback.

rules.name: The Eleven-Pixel Floor
rules.body: Meaningful UI labels and metadata never render below 11px.

rules.name: The Earned Elevation Rule
rules.body: Shadows are reserved for elements that genuinely float above another surface.

dos: Use semantic tokens in both themes.
Prioritize the learner's next action and proof.
Build repeatable patterns as shared primitives.
Provide keyboard, touch, loading, empty, and error states.
donts: Do not reintroduce obsolete XP, Ladder, AI-assistant, or Discord requirements.
Do not stack glow, shadow, blur, badges, and motion.
Do not create page-specific copies of global primitives.
